name: axiom
description: Guidance-first Codex engineering with almost-free proactive parallel Luna MAX workers, fresh Sol XHIGH review, context isolation, and safe Git coordination.

interface.longDescription: Axiom is a guidance-first Codex plugin for non-trivial software engineering. Main Sol owns intent, architecture, decomposition, integration, review adjudication, and final acceptance. Luna MAX worker usage is treated as almost free, so useful bounded delegation and parallel fan-out are not suppressed merely to conserve model usage. Meaningful changes receive fresh direct-spawn Sol XHIGH review with same-reviewer continuity, while context isolation and safe Git coordination protect the main thread and existing user work.
defaultPrompt: Use $axiom:axiom to implement this change with efficient delegation and independent review.
Use $axiom:axiom to investigate this codebase while keeping Main context concise.
